data.question: Write a program that reads a number. Print the number itself when it is a multiple of both 5 and 7 or when it is below 7; otherwise print its remainder by 5 and then its remainder by 7.

brief.summary: Prints the number itself in special cases, otherwise its remainders by 5 and 7.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a number. Print the number itself when it is a multiple of both 5 and 7 or when it is below 7; otherwise print its remainder by 5 and then its remainder by 7.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: The condition is (number % 5 == 0 and number % 7 == 0) or number < 7; otherwise two print calls run.
